method: The probe author (Claude Opus 5) opened every contact sheet in artifacts/rel_visual/ and graded each tile by eye. T = the relation is really there, F = it is not, U = the tile does not let one decide (usually one endpoint is invisible because it is a single tiny segment, or the frame is dominated by a large object). The false rate is reported over the RESOLVABLE tiles (T+F) and, as a worst case, with every U counted as F.

criteria.CONNECTED_TO: a free endpoint of the red object physically lands on the blue object's ink
criteria.PART_OF: the red object lies inside the blue one AND touches it
criteria.INSIDE: the red object lies inside the blue object's real outline
criteria.ADJACENT: the two objects are neighbours at the stated gap and neither contains the other
criteria.ALIGNED: the two centres share the stated axis within the stated tolerance
criteria.LEADER_TO: the red object is a LEADER (callout) whose free end points at the blue object and whose other end carries the text - a dimension line, a table rule or a door swing is NOT a leader
criteria.LABEL_ANCHOR: the text really names the red object (not a neighbouring one)
criteria.REPEATED_WITH: red and blue are the same motif

layer: default v03_objects parameters (the defective arc closure is IN)

guarded_grades.layer: arc_min_pts=6 (rectangles no longer become circumscribed circles); same sampling rule, artifacts/rel_visual_guarded/

notes.CONTAINS: CONTAINS is emitted by the builder as the mirror of every INSIDE pair, so its population is identical; one sheet was graded as a consistency check and it reproduces the INSIDE failure mode.
notes.LEADER_TO: every F on a stamp/table block is a table rule line taken for a leader; several F on drawings are DIMENSION lines (a leader-shaped polyline whose text is a number).
notes.LABEL_ANCHOR: every F in tiles 12-17 is a stamp/table block, where each text sits next to some rule line and the nearest-text rule pairs them meaninglessly.
notes.ALIGNED: no F was found - alignment is true by construction; the informative number is not the false rate but the distance between 'aligned' objects (see rel_gapcensus).
